name: Vadrok, the Thunder-Raptor
description: The apex monster of the Raugrin triome on Ikoria, a massive catlike dragon with blue-white flame.

timeline.summary: Long ago Vadrok burned a human sanctuary to ash, erasing all memory of it.

timeline.summary: Jirina Kudro leads Drannith survivors into Vadrok's lair to lure in Lukka.
timeline.quote: Jirina Kudro led a column of survivors from the destroyed city of Drannith into Vadrok's lair

timeline.summary: Vadrok's flames strip Lukka's corrupted biomass, letting Vadrok extract the planeswalker, and it discards Lukka's corpse.
timeline.quote: the apex monster's magical flames stripped Lukka's corrupted biomass, letting Vadrok extract the planeswalker
